_about: Word budget for everything the chat model reads as instructions, and the most tools it may be offered (CHAT-DEVELOPMENT.md rules 5 and 6). A brake, not a goal: a part may not grow past its budget plus its raises, and a clearer longer rewrite is a fine reason for a raise. When a PR shrinks a part or merges tools, lower the number in the same PR so the space can't quietly refill. Example conversations are exempt.

raises.reason: CHAT_NARRATE's conversation_reply variant (NOTE_TOOL, lib/ai.js) is counted beside the current one while the flag is tried. Only one is offered per turn; when the flag is settled the other is deleted and this raise dropped.

The same taste-guide material field, which update_profile carries in its description (October 22).
